title: complete-signup: roster and whitelist linkage
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: models/user (schema, repo) and src/app/actions/complete-signup.ts implementing section 5.2 exactly (read references/signin-flow.md first).

Student path: email matches ^[0-9]{10}@htu\.edu\.gh$ -> roster lookup in the current academic year inside a transaction -> create users/{uid} with profile.course_id from the roster, roles ['student'] -> set claims {roles, activeRole:'student', registered:true, profileComplete:true} -> set roster.user_uid and signup_completed_at.
Staff path: lookup staff_whitelist/{email}; require is_active; create users doc from whitelist (roles, programmes); claims with profileComplete:false; set whitelist.user_uid.

Same index with a different uid -> HttpError 409 and an audit log identity_conflict; not found -> registered:false claims and a result code the client uses to route to /not-registered. Never delete the Auth user.
After success the client calls getIdToken(true) and refreshes the __session cookie; wire this into the login flow from 02-01.
Emulator tests (tests/server): student happy path, staff happy path, unknown email, inactive staff, identity conflict, second sign-in is idempotent.
rules: course_id comes only from the roster entry and is immutable afterwards
acceptance: A student signup yields claims with registered:true, profileComplete:true and the roster course_id
